shape-walls.description: Shape Walls is a fun and challenging puzzle game where you arrange shape pieces to reveal hidden objects. Tap to rotate the pieces and fit them into the correct outline. With its intuitive gameplay and engaging mechanics, Shape Walls offers hours of entertainment. Play Shape Walls now and test your puzzle-solving skills!
